description: This file defines the QueryResult class in the org.openmrs.api.db.hibernate package. The class encapsulates a collection of predicates and orderings used for constructing database queries, providing methods to manage and access these collections.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: A class that holds lists of query predicates and orders, allowing construction and modification of query criteria.

methods.name: QueryResult
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the predicates and orders lists.

methods.name: QueryResult
methods.description: Parameterized constructor accepting existing lists of predicates and orders.

methods.name: getPredicates
methods.description: Returns the list of query predicates.

methods.name: setPredicates
methods.description: Sets the list of query predicates.

methods.name: addPredicates
methods.description: Adds a list of predicates to the existing predicates list.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns the list of query orders.

methods.name: setOrders
methods.description: Sets the list of query orders.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Adds a single order to the orders list.
